changelog: v1.3: Bigger Send & input bar, clean Kick Vote popup, right floating action dock, flush header player alignment, and pure clean static mode.
added: Right-side floating glass action dock (▲, ▼, 🌐, Copy, Reply) completely free of the Send button
Clean single-choice Kick Vote popup on player names (no emojis, no scrollbars)
Pure clean static mode (completely hides transparent bars and outlines when Chat Bar Anim is Off)
changed: Stretched bottom dock (46px height) with a larger 76px Send button
Eliminated left-side spacing for chat text and input bar
Removed gap between header players block and main navigation tabs
